claims.text: The Schur transposition map \(\omega:\Lambda_{\mathbb Z}\to\Lambda_{\mathbb Z}\), \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\), is an integral ring involution and descends to an integral ring isomorphism \[ \omega_{r,q}:\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda/I_{q,r}. \]

The transposed family \[ \mathcal T=\{\bar s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\} \] maps under \(\omega_{r,q}\) to \[ \omega_{r,q}(\mathcal T) =\{\bar s_\nu:j^i\subseteq\nu\subseteq(j^i,b^a)\}, \] precisely the family covered by 2024 Theorem 1.2 for \(v'\). Consequently \(\mathcal T\) is minimal whenever that theorem is invoked for \(v'\). The requested transpose-involution reduction is established.
